title: Direct phone sharing through Tailscale without a PC
summary: Adds an Android-hosted private viewer, a direct connection workflow and copyable pairing details. Requires a new Android build; physical two-phone validation is pending.

changes.detail: Android hosts the viewer on its Tailscale IPv4 address, with random single-use pairing, owner approval, expiry, network-loss stop and authenticated controls.
Phone page defaults to direct Tailscale; separates sharing and viewing, remembers viewer address, copies address/code and keeps HTTPS relay as an advanced option.
Removed the hosted-relay requirement from direct mode; no PC or public relay is required.
Unsupported native builds and missing VPN addresses receive setup guidance rather than silently using the relay.

validation.name: Two physical phones
validation.detail: No Android device currently connected to ADB; Tailscale routing, capture, input and lifecycle require device validation. No deployment or installation performed.
